inlines.v: INTOX'ICATE, verb transitive [in and Latin toxicum, which, Pliny informs us, is from taxa, a species of tree.] 1. To inebriate; to make drunk; as with spirituous liquor. As with new wine intoxicated both, They swim in mirth-- 2. To excite the spirits to a kind of delirium; to elate to enthusiasm, frenzy or madness. Success may sometimes intoxicate a man of sobriety. An enthusiast may be intoxicated and zeal. INTOX'ICATE, adjective Inebriated.
